html:
SMTO-POL-0028 — SMTO needs your approval before this action runs

GUID: 4ce45d36-c812-5933-a33b-de9b78a7e791
Slug: operation-approval-required
Domain: POL · Subsystem: operation

What happened

  • The Task has paused at an action your permission rules say to ask about. Nothing has run yet, and it won't run until you decide.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Find the Approval needed card under the Task's reply and read the action it describes. The card shows exactly what will run, so you can decide whether you want it.
  2. Select Approve once to let it run, or Deny / stop task to stop it. The Task waits at this point until you decide.
  3. To be asked less often, pick a wider choice in Apply decision to, or select Open Permissions to change your rules. Your permission rules decide which actions need your approval each time.

What success looks like

  • The card goes away and the Task continues, or it stops if you denied the action.

If it still fails

  • If no approval card is showing, reload the page. If it's still missing, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Execution preflight received an ask decision (approval_required) from the permission, capability or resource authority instead of permission to dispatch, so the operation is held unexecuted pending an explicit decision.

What this means

  • Execution authorization returned an ask decision rather than permission to dispatch; the operation remains pending explicit approval. Policy and approval decisions are scoped to their owning operation. Existing receipts determine prior effects; this explanation neither grants authority nor changes retry ownership.

Why this can happen

  • Execution authorization returned an ask decision rather than permission to dispatch; the operation remains pending explicit approval.

How to diagnose it

  • Review the exact pending capability, arguments and scope in the task's approval control.

How to fix it

  • Review the pending operation's approval_pending entry and authority request in the run, and record an allow or deny decision through the approval flow with the current authority_request_id. Change the Permissions policy only if this action should stop requiring approval.
  • Review the pending operation in the task and choose a permitted approval decision.

Retry and execution caution

  • Review the pending operation in the task and choose a permitted approval decision.

How to verify the fix

  • The owning checkpoint records a current allowed decision or a deliberate denial before dispatch proceeds.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained evidence or retry an operation whose effect is unknown.

Technical notes

  • Policy and approval decisions are scoped to their owning operation. Existing receipts determine prior effects; this explanation neither grants authority nor changes retry ownership.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
